Sukhi13wan,I-701001 --- Page 5 --- (i) AGANCHENGANI la ki-tapko seon anga bakgni dake sualaha.
Skanggipa bakara "Katta Jikse ba Kujikserang" aro gnigipa "Poedorang" ong:a.
Kujikse aro Poedorangko seengon, anga darangni segimin ki-tap ba kattarangoniko ra'gate seade dongja, indiba badiabarango apsan kattarangko semangenchimode uarangna kemako bi-enga.
Ku jikserangko seanio badiaba kattarangde apsan melijanaba gnang, maina angni atchiram jolo naikai aganrongachim, uarango pangchakesa seaha.

la ki-tapko seanio chu-sokna dakchakahanina Nokgipa Isolko mitelchenga aro tangka-paisako on'e dakchakahanina Di- rector of Art and Culturc Meghalaya, Shillong-ko mitelanbaksa Williamnagar District Librarian aro Staff-ko mitela; maina uamangba segrik-jotgrikanio angko dakchakbeaha.
Dingtangmancha Pa Rickas D.
Shirako mitela maina ia Ki-tapko ong-atna, banan(spelling)rangko tik onge jakkalna mesoke aro kurpattie on-aha.
Pa Shan D.
Sangma koba mitela maina uaba, pilak tarina nanganirangko tarian baksa, bakrangko donjujae on'anio dakchakaha.Una agreba angni jikgipa, Ma N.
Shira- koba dingtangnancha mitela, maina uaba katta sandianirango angko dakchakbeaha.
Sena-jotna changpajaoba, je skanirangko Isol angna On-aha, uarangko jakkalenba ia ki-tapko seaha.
Haida ian da ororo poraienggipa chadamberangna adita dakchakani ong:chongmotgen ine anga kadonga.
la ki-tapko anga, sianggimin angni pagipa., Nelson A.
Sangma aro magipa, Tolmoni B.Marak -na on-kangan (dedicate ka-an) baksa atchiram songtang: Ganolgre-ko gisik ra-kame dongna ine seaha.
Ki-tapko seanio banoba gualanirang On-anina mitelbegen.
Senokgipa W.B.
Marak --- Page 6 --- (iv) AGANDAPANI: Salantio A-chik ku-sikko agananio aro sea jotanio badita ga-kime agana aro sena-jotna man'a inditan su-ua aro knatoa.
Indake aganna gita an-ching noko aroba songsalo salantio agangipa kattarang baksana nitoe katta jikserangko jakkaina manode uan knatobatgipa ong'a ine nikna man'a.
Unigiminan daororo.
dingtangdingtang poraiani gadangrango katta kujikserangko rachapaha.
Wilnen B.
Marak,(Cheangkalpa) ia nanganiko nike dingchikbee kattarangko sandi kolame 'Kujikse ba Katta- Jikserang aro Poedorang' ine katta bichongko done ku:jikse aro adita poedorangko see chapa ka-ataha.
A.chik chadamberang jatni nangipa dakbewal aro maniani bewalrangna simsakgijanichi uarang ong siroroangengaha.
Ia ong'a obostarangko nike, Kitapko segipa salantio manderangni jenggi tanganiko namdapatna ba de-mesanagita adita poedorangkoba seaha.
Uni ia namgipa kam jatni namgipa hewalko tangchapilna gita poraigipa sakantina dakchakbeani ong'gen ine ka donga.
RICKAS D.
